slots.label: font-face-label text-ctl-xs tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.field: appearance-none w-full h-ctl-h pl-3 pr-9 bg-field text-ink-body border-[length:var(--bw-field)] rounded-field font-body text-ctl cursor-pointer transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-hover focus:outline-none
slots.caret: absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) text-[length:var(--icon-sm)]
slots.iconWrap: absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none inline-flex text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) text-[length:var(--icon-md)]

valid.field: border-success ring-[length:var(--focus-width)] ring-success/16 focus:border-secondary focus:ring-[length:var(--focus-width)] focus:ring-secondary/16
